releaseNotes: Keeps the hardware-confirmed Notes 0.12.19 editor, mixed colors, resize and geometry behavior unchanged
Removes the redundant manual Speichern button because Notes already persist continuously through Autosave
Fullscreen is now a distraction-free paper workspace: Notes Pro header/card, Speichern, Mit LuMa AI öffnen, sidebar, page/tool controls and text option bars are hidden
The compact top-right fullscreen HUD remains and shows only the currently selected tool plus the X exit control
No new APK is required; Shell 1.1.0 remains sufficient
